core.name: Button
Input
Field
Switch
Checkbox
core.fallbackCss:
.checkbox, .radio { accent-color: var(--accent); }
.checkbox:focus-visible, .radio:focus-visible { outline: var(--focus-ring-width) solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: var(--focus-ring-offset); }
